<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=implemented_on_main confidence=high -->
Thanks for reporting this. An automated hermes-sweeper review confirmed that the setup behavior described here is now implemented on main.

- Commit `411faf08bd678fe3e49b22afcef1e9fd2d7f5592` (`fix(soul): installers seed the real default persona, upgrade legacy empty templates`) fixes the old curl-installer comment-only `SOUL.md` scaffold and upgrades existing untouched scaffolds safely in `hermes_cli/config.py:893`.
- Current `scripts/install.sh:1795` seeds a real default persona instead of the old empty-comment template.
- `tools/memory_tool.py:5` and `:280` define `USER.md` as the persistent user-profile store and map `target="user"` to that file; the profile is enabled by default in `hermes_cli/config.py:2175`.
- The current memory guide explicitly distinguishes `MEMORY.md` from `USER.md` and documents user identity/preferences under `target="user"` in `website/docs/user-guide/features/memory.md:13` and `:78`.
- This fix shipped in `v2026.7.1`; the cross-referenced clarification effort in #30129 is reflected by the current documentation.

Closing as implemented on main.
